name: Hairy Cell Leukemia

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Consensus Diagnostic Criteria for Hairy Cell Leukemia

criteria.description: Presence of characteristic 'hairy' cytoplasmic projections on peripheral blood smear or bone marrow aspirate
Expression of CD19, CD20, CD22, CD11c, CD25, CD103, and annexin A1 on leukemic cells by flow cytometry or immunohistochemistry
Bone marrow biopsy showing reticulin fibrosis and infiltration by hairy cells
Detection of BRAF V600E mutation in leukemic cells

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of characteristic hairy cells on morphology plus confirmatory immunophenotyping and bone marrow biopsy findings
diagnosticCriteria.notes: BRAF V600E mutation testing supports diagnosis but is not mandatory

pathognomonic.notes: Due to bone marrow infiltration and fibrosis

pathognomonic.symptomName: Hairy cells in peripheral blood smear

common.notes: Due to anemia and systemic illness

occasional.notes: Less common than in other leukemias

rare.notes: Rarely due to CNS involvement or paraneoplastic phenomena

laboratory: Presence of hairy cells on peripheral blood smear
Elevated serum soluble interleukin-2 receptor (sIL-2R) levels
imaging: Splenomegaly on abdominal ultrasound or CT scan
genetic: BRAF V600E mutation detected in majority of cases
other: Bone marrow biopsy showing reticulin fibrosis and hairy cell infiltration
Flow cytometry immunophenotyping positive for CD11c, CD25, CD103, and annexin A1

distinguishingFeatures: Splenomegaly with villous lymphocytes rather than hairy cells

redFlags: Massive splenomegaly causing abdominal discomfort or early satiety
Rapid clinical deterioration or transformation to aggressive lymphoma
references: Swerdlow SH, Campo E, Harris NL, et al. WHO Classification of Tumours of Haematopoietic and Lymphoid Tissues. IARC; 2017.
Grever MR, Abdel-Wahab O. Hairy Cell Leukemia: 2020 Update on Diagnosis, Risk Stratification, and Treatment. Am J Hematol. 2020.
Tiacci E, Trifonov V, Schiavoni G, et al. BRAF Mutations in Hairy-Cell Leukemia. N Engl J Med. 2011.
